AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I'm a software engineer and technical leader with %YEARS%+ years of experience turning complex business problems into elegant, dependable software. Today I serve as Assistant Vice President at Delta Capita, helping shape technology for the financial-services industry.

Previously at CareMonitor, I led frontend engineering for mission-critical healthcare platforms — growing the UI team from 3 to 8 engineers and shipping Telehealth, e-Prescribing and Scheduling products trusted by 15K+ users.

I care deeply about clean architecture, performance, accessibility and developer experience — and about mentoring teams to raise the bar together. Outside of work, I build products for small businesses and side projects that blend utility with craft.
